Dropped: oklch(0.262 0.021 52) (#2d221b, --ink; 93 elements, text); oklch(0.945 0.016 80) (#f3ece1, --cream; 66 elements, text); oklch(0.79 0.128 74) (#ebad54, --amber; 32 elements, text/border); oklch(0.4 0.02 55) (#51453e, --line-dark; 30 elements, border); oklch(0.918 0.02 74) (#ece2d6, --paper-3; 18 elements, background); oklch(0.282 0.02 50) (#322721, --charcoal-2; 6 elements, background); oklch(0.262 0.021 52 / 0.32) (#2d221b52; 4 elements, border); oklch(0.97 0.01 82 / 0.9) (#f8f5eee6; 3 elements, background); oklch(0.97 0.01 82 / 0.92) (#f8f5eeeb; 3 elements, background); oklch(0.74344 0.01352 72.4) (#b1aba3; 3 elements, text); rgba(255, 248, 240, 0.82) (#fff8f0d1; 2 elements, text); oklch(0.515 0.108 40) (#9a4f35, --terracotta-deep; 2 elements, text); oklch(0.945 0.016 80 / 0.32) (#f3ece152; 2 elements, border); oklch(0.9304 0.03596 80.24) (#f5e6ce; 1 elements, background); rgba(255, 248, 240, 0.9) (#fff8f0e6; 1 elements, text); oklch(0.16 0.02 45 / 0.55) (#150a068c; 1 elements, background); oklch(0.9466 0.02534 80.96) (#f6ecdb; 1 elements, background); oklch(0.945 0.016 80 / 0.34) (#f3ece157; 1 elements, border); oklch(0.945 0.016 80 / 0.42) (#f3ece16b; 1 elements, border)
Radius: home-only and cross-page modes agree (22px non-pill, 999px pill).

Two stylesheet stacks render the site: home uses shared/tokens.css + atelier.css; the 5 other pages are a React design-system build (_ds/fr-scopa-design-system-…/styles.css, fr-* classes, #dc-root) — same tokens, same computed values.
No og:image / og:* meta on any page; 5 design-system pages have an empty <title> and no meta description.
Images hero-machine.jpg (5 pages), espresso-pour.jpg (5), tea-moment.jpg (4) are reused content across pages; no CSS background images exist, so no background-motif system component.
machines and blog pages render <image-slot> placeholder tiles for several products/posts on the source itself.

voice.heroSubcopy: The first Fréscopa machine with a feel for your mornings. It learns what you love, softens or sharpens to match your mood, and quietly takes care of the rest. Barista craft, kept warm by a little intelligence.

heroImage.alt: The Fréscopa Atelier on a sunlit kitchen counter, steam rising from a freshly pulled cup.
heroImage.rectBasis: section.hero rect at 1440 (census surfaces #main > section:nth-of-type(1)); img is absolute inset:0 object-fit:cover

voice.heroMediumNote: hero is a still photo; shared/hero.js only art-directs copy position (--hero-copy-top / --hero-copy-max) from data-hero-* image metadata — no video/canvas/lottie
voice.firstParagraph: For a hundred mornings, the Atelier watches how you like your cup, then makes it that way without being asked. No apps to fuss over, no settings to memorise. Just coffee that feels like it knows you, because, cup by cup, it has come to.
voice.tagline: The first Fréscopa coffee machine with a feel for your mornings. It learns your taste, matches your mood, and takes care of the rest.

tone.evidence: second-person, sensory and unhurried ("Warm mornings, made effortless."; "No appointment, no pressure — just a good cup and a warm room."), short declarative headlines ending in full stops, British spelling (flavour, centre, memorise)
